input.value: rear-ended by other vehicle going approximately 35 mph with no braking
entire trunk crushed into back seat, vehicle totaled

input.rationale: Motor vehicle collision with total loss and bodily injury resulting from impact of other vehicle.

Totaled vehicle plus injury to policyholder (whiplash and sprained wrist are bodily injuries that require medical evaluation and may escalate), clearly exceeds property damage thresholds and warrants immediate adjuster attention.

input.claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan was rear-ended on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15 am by an unbraked vehicle traveling ~35 mph, resulting in total loss of vehicle (trunk crushed into back seat) and injuries to the policyholder including whiplash and sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information available.
